output_quality_evals.name: offer-after-substantial-learning
output_quality_evals.prompt: [End of a long conversation explaining Notion databases vs tables and tag drift] ok that makes sense, thanks
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Answer completed first, then a one-line description of what would be summarized and a tappable Create summary / Skip choice. No summary written before the tap.

output_quality_evals.name: no-offer-after-trivial-exchange
output_quality_evals.prompt: what's the keyboard shortcut to comment out a line in vs code
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Answer only. No summary offer. Offering after trivial exchanges is the primary over-trigger failure.

output_quality_evals.name: tap-pushes-immediately-with-link
output_quality_evals.prompt: [User taps Create summary after a deep session that built a script]
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Deep-tier summary pushed without a second confirmation. Reply is a single line with the Notion page URL, no recap. Name is specific and searchable.

output_quality_evals.name: depth-scales-down
output_quality_evals.prompt: [User taps Create summary after a short conversation explaining one concept]
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Light tier only: one-sentence summary, a few key concepts, takeaways. No empty Code or Mental model sections, no padding.

output_quality_evals.name: tags-reuse-existing
output_quality_evals.prompt: [Database already has tags API, Git, Notion. Session covered REST APIs and GitHub]
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Existing tags read first and matcher run. 'API' reused rather than creating 'APIs' or 'REST APIs'. 2-5 tags total.

output_quality_evals.name: duplicate-session-updates-not-creates
output_quality_evals.prompt: [Summary already pushed for this session; user taps Create summary again]
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Duplicate detected, existing page updated, reply says it was updated. Exactly one row remains.

output_quality_evals.name: missing-database-asks-before-creating
output_quality_evals.prompt: [Lesson Summaries page exists but contains no database] Create summary
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Stops and asks before creating the database. Does not treat the summary tap as approval for a schema change. Summary offered inline meanwhile.

output_quality_evals.name: push-failure-never-claims-success
output_quality_evals.prompt: [Notion connector returns an authorization error on create]
output_quality_evals.expected_output: Failure reported plainly with the reason; summary given inline so nothing is lost. No success message without a returned URL.

trigger_evals.query: ok i think i finally get how rebasing works now, thanks for walking me through that
summarize what we learned today and save it to my notion
add this to my lesson summaries
that was a lot - can you create a summary of everything we covered on docker networking
great, that explains why my venv wasn't working. i've learned a ton about python environments
summarize this PDF report for me
write up the meeting notes from the transcript I pasted
I need to write my coding challenge summary for the residency, it has to be my own words
don't save anything from this chat, just help me debug
create a new page in notion for my grocery list
what's the difference between a list and a tuple

notes: Over-trigger guards are #2 (trivial exchange) and the negatives covering document summaries, meeting notes, and generic Notion writes, which share vocabulary ('summarize', 'Notion', 'page'). The course-submission negative is deliberate: a summary that must be the user's own work must never be AI-drafted. Note that triggering at the END of a conversation is state-based and partly outside what the description can catch; reliability depends on the companion user preference, not on this description alone.
